ideas_declared.rationale: note p.2: 'price > 200MA = positive long term trend' implies the converse should be inferior. This is the direct mirror of trend-ma's regime_filter_standalone (close > sma(200)), not re-tested here -- see module docstring. direction='down' means the hypothesis under test is that the 20-bar forward hit rate is *below* the same-bars baseline while price sits under the 200-day SMA; an edge that runs positive is a rejection of that claim, not merely inconclusive.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: 20-bar forward hit rate below the 200-day SMA does not fall below the same-bars baseline
ideas_declared.source: note p.2 'price > 200MA = positive long term trend' (converse)

ideas_declared.rationale: note p.2: 'trade only when broader market context is favorable', applied as a gate on a risk-managed entry (10% stop, 15-bar cap) rather than on a bare MA-alignment signal -- this is the risk-framework reading of the claim, not a crossover test. Paired with unfiltered_pullback (no gate) and unfavorable_regime_pullback (gate inverted) with every other parameter held fixed, so the marginal contribution of the regime gate on this class of trade can be read directly off the three edges.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: 10-bar forward hit rate does not exceed the same-bars baseline, or does not exceed unfiltered_pullback's edge
ideas_declared.source: note p.2 'trade only when broader market context is favorable'

ideas_declared.rationale: Identical to regime_filtered_pullback with the 'close > sma(200)' gate removed -- entry structure, exit, horizon, holding cap and stop all held fixed. The counterfactual that isolates whether the regime gate itself is doing work, not just whether rsi(14) < 30 mean-reversion works in general.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: 20-bar forward hit rate does not exceed the same-bars baseline
ideas_declared.source: regime-gate marginal-contribution probe, paired with regime_filtered_pullback

ideas_declared.rationale: The trade the note's risk framework discourages: buying an oversold bounce while price is already below the 200-day trend filter -- 'catching a falling knife' in a context the note itself calls unfavorable. direction is still declared 'up' (this idea asks whether the trade is a positive-edge trade on its own terms, not whether it under- or out-performs); the comparison against regime_filtered_pullback's edge and mechanics (win rate, max drawdown, worst trade) is what actually answers 'does the regime filter prevent catastrophic loss', in the report.
ideas_declared.falsifies_if: 10-bar forward hit rate does not exceed the same-bars baseline
